meta.name: Classmate
meta.description: The story follows a group of college students navigating the complexities of romance, family turmoil, and personal secrets. Avi is caught in a dual struggle: he is desperately trying to reunite his estranged parents while simultaneously fighting his hidden feelings for Taani. Meanwhile, their classmate Isha harbors a secret obsession with Avi, who completely ignores her. Overwhelmed by personal insecurities and pressured by a dominant mother determined to arrange her marriage, Isha rejects a genuine proposal from another peer in her relentless pursuit of Avi. As their individual secrets and unrequited feelings clash, the group is forced into dramatic confrontations that test the boundaries of their relationships.
